administrator_login_correction.other_three_diagrams: Customer unchanged; Barista and Manager login/business requests separated in the subsequent correction.

staff_login_separation.login_and_business_requests: Separate arrows for Barista 2.1a/2.1b and Manager 3.1a/3.1b; Administrator login 4.1 separate from menu item submission 4.2.
staff_login_separation.grouping_review: Every arrow carries at most two logical data items. Record fields remain together. Customer 1.5 carries new order plus payment status; 1.7 carries confirmation plus status update. All other arrows carry one logical payload.
staff_login_separation.copies: Three byte-identical project JSON copies; updated native PNGs also copied to deliverables.
staff_login_separation.visual_validation: All corrected diagrams imported into Threat Dragon; Administrator, Barista and Manager native PNG exports visually inspected.

authentication_result_review.source_vs_assumption: Section 5.2 specifies login and backend checks. Separate success/failure responses are explicit modeling assumptions in arrow descriptions, diagram descriptions, and visible footnotes. No token, cookie, session protocol, credential store, or separate authorization-response exchange is asserted.
authentication_result_review.authorization: Checks remain backend notes and process descriptions; business replies remain distinct from authentication results.
authentication_result_review.preservation: Customer diagram, owner metadata, all original cells and all 128 threat attachments preserved. Existing business flows retained; three result flows added.
authentication_result_review.data_grouping: Maximum two logical data items per arrow reviewed; credential and record fields remain one logical payload.
authentication_result_review.structural_checks: Official schema, all endpoints/ports, labels, unique cell IDs, flow directions, three identical JSON copies, identical deliverable PNG copies: PASS.
authentication_result_review.visual_validation: Corrected project imported into Threat Dragon. All three staff native PNG exports inspected for directions, connections, readable labels, visible assumption notes and absence of editor selection outlines.
